brief: William Riordian, flying a Centurion and 3 of his pirate buddies ambush Grayson. He claims Grayson stole his smuggling routes with Tayla and there ain't room for two of them in town. Grayson responds with something snarky and sarcastic.
triggers_text: We are travelling from Oakham base to the 119ce jump point in the pentonville system. we are on tayla's final mission, delivering more brilliacne to new constantinople.
outcome_text: William Riordian - a Confident Ace flying a Centurion, and 3 Confident Pro Pirate Talon fighters ambush Grayson at the 119ce jum point.
